pressure_note: not stated (ordinary pressure; pycnometer and dilatometer work at 25 C)
volume_basis_evidence: concentration column headed 'c/mole l.-1' (mole per litre)
title_as_printed: Apparent molar volumes of dilute electrolyte solutions

value.what: apparent molar volume of the electrolyte phi_V, calculated by the author from the dilatometric volume change

value2.what: measured volume contraction on mixing the capsule solution (solution of Table 1, number given in first column) with water in the magnetically operated dilatometer; sign printed as -dV

salt_from_column.parse: text after the comma gives the salt formula; the number before the comma is the Table 1 stock solution used in the capsule

composition.other_species: in-scope salts: Na2SO4, MgCl2, CaCl2; out of the six-ion set: HCl, KNO3, K2SO4, BaCl2, LaCl3 (rows kept). c_final is the final concentration after dilution in the dilatometer

extra_unmapped: mole solute (amount of salt in the capsule, a sample size)
conversion_needs: molarity to molality needs the solution density
mole solute not needed for the datum
notes: Image read for all 35 rows; image and text layer agree except for OCR slips in spacing/decimal characters. Repeated stock-solution numbers refer to separate dilutions. Table 3 (limiting values from extrapolation) is derived and not extracted.
